desc: Ideation complete: Plan to use DFS with a `path` list and `last_seen` dictionary to track the last index of each value on the current root-to-node path.
Build an adjacency list representation of the tree from the `edges` input, storing both neighbor and edge weight.
Implement the DFS function that traverses the tree, maintaining `path`, `last_seen`, and cumulative distance.
Inside DFS, calculate the special path length ending at the current node using `last_seen` and update global results.
Backtrack correctly by restoring `last_seen` after processing children.
